item.title: Libertyville man accused of sending threatening letters to federal judges
item.description: <p>A Libertyville man has been charged with sending threatening letters to judges in Florida and Texas, according to the U.S. Attorney's Office.</p><p>James Lebuhn, 65, is charged with two counts of mailing a threatening communication, according to the U.S. attorney’s office.</p><p>He is accused of sending threatening letters to U.S. District Court judges in Amarillo, Texas, and Fort Pierce, Florida, though charging documents didn’t detail the threats made in the letters or when they were sent.<

item.title: Woman injured in East Garfield Park shooting
item.description: <p>A woman was hospitalized after being shot Thursday evening in East Garfield Park, according to Chicago police.</p><p>The woman, 40, was inside a vehicle in the 3100 block of West Madison Avenue at 8:01 p.m. when she was shot in the calf, police said. She took herself to Mount Sinai Hospital where she was reported in critical condition.</p><p>No one is in custody.<br></p>
